theorems.name: Submission.rsod_c1ab_utr_remainder_sup_control
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ C : Set (Rn n), IsClosed C → (∀ x ∈ C, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) → ∃ η : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ, (∀ k, Measurable (η k)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ C, Tendsto (fun k => η k x) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, 0 < ‖y - x‖ → ‖y - x‖ < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) → ‖f y - f x - fderiv ℝ f x (y - x)‖ ≤ η k x * ‖y - x‖
